messages.en: Are you already up ahead? You walk so fast!
I'll just wait at the shop. Take your time, no need to rush to catch up.

senses.en_definition: To do, perform, or carry out a task, action, or activity.

messages.en: Farid, what do I need to do before tomorrow's demo? I've never run a session like this before.
Check the slides first, then try opening all the links. Just in case any of them don't work on the day.
Okay, I'll do that now. I'll message you again if anything comes up.

senses.en_definition: To do it; to carry out a previously mentioned task or action.

messages.en: I've got to give a presentation on my own in front of the whole class tomorrow. I'm so nervous.
You've practised loads of times, right? I know you can do it.
True. I'll give it another go tonight.

senses.en_definition: To pass by, go along, or move through a place.

collocations.en: pass in front of the house

senses.en_definition: Past or previous; ago when following an expression of time.
Then; next; after that, introducing a subsequent action.
Able to manage or bring oneself to do something, especially to eat; usually used in negative expressions.
Straight on; directly to or as far as a place, chiefly in literary usage.

messages.en: I'll be passing your place later. Want a lift? Let's grab something to eat together.
Yes! What time will you get here, roughly? I'm not ready yet.
Around seven. I'll message you when I'm nearby.
